review_note: Official NYSE/ICE 2025 yearly trading calendar, read directly (not from a search summary). Cross-checked for internal consistency against nre/calendar-2026.json (same 10-holiday count; same early-close pattern of day-after-Thanksgiving and Christmas-Eve, plus a day-before-July-4th early close specific to 2025's July 4 falling on a Friday). Columbus Day and Veterans Day are bank/bond-market holidays only, shown on the source as open days for NYSE equities, and are correctly absent here.
amendment_2026_10_02: 2025-01-09 added as a holiday: a real, full NYSE and Nasdaq closure for the National Day of Mourning for former President Jimmy Carter (died 2024-12-29), confirmed via multiple independent real sources (NYSE's and Nasdaq's own announcements, contemporaneous financial press). This is not a correction of the original PDF read -- the official yearly calendar was published before Carter's death and could not have included a closure announced in response to it. Found because nre.event_acquire's own real dry run reported a genuine missing_sessions gap for love-step3-2024-12-12 (workflow run 36979299010); checked against every other already-built event in this project (M1, M2 step 2, M2 step 3 batches 1-2) before fixing -- none of their own labeled windows span this date, so only the not-yet-attested love-step3-2024-12-12 is affected.
